question.html:
a

Photons of wavelength 468 nm are incident on a metallic surface. The maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons is 1.8 eV.

Calculate

a.i the work function of the surface, in eV. [2]

a.ii the longest wavelength of a photon that will eject an electron from this surface. [2]

b.i In an experiment, alpha particles of initial kinetic energy 5.9 MeV are directed at stationary nuclei of lead (). Show that the distance of closest approach is about 4 × 10−14 m. [2]

b.ii The radius of a nucleus of is 7.1 × 10−15 m. Explain why there will be no deviations from Rutherford scattering in the experiment in (b)(i). [2]
